name: ai-career-coach
description: A long-term career positioning partner that builds a persistent career profile, evaluates job fit, and creates truthful tailored applications.

interface.shortDescription: Build a career profile and create stronger applications
interface.longDescription: Build a career encyclopedia that improves over time, evaluate job descriptions against personalized criteria, and generate truthful, persona-targeted CVs and cover letters.
defaultPrompt: Set up my career profile from my existing CV.
Analyze this job description and tell me whether I should apply.
Create a tailored CV for the role I analyzed.
